# Customer Service Call Record and Account Discretionary Fee Dispute
Agent: Dmitri Coleman | Reviewing Lead: Grace Sandoval | Date: 03/12/2026

## Account Summary
| Field | Information |
| --- | --- |
| Account Holder | Colleen Rowland |
| Account Number | 4409-8812-04 |
| Account Type | Brightwater Premier Checking |
| Current Balance | $1,842.10 |
| Date Account Opened | 08/14/2021 |
| Fee in Dispute | Maintenance Service Fee of $25.00 assessed 03/10/2026 |

## Contact Notes and Verification
Customer Colleen Rowland contacted customer care at 10:14 AM EST regarding a $25.00 monthly maintenance fee posted on 03/10/2026.
- Caller identity verified via one-time passcode to primary mobile phone.
- Customer stated she maintains a balance above $1,500.00 and inquired why the fee was charged.
- Agent reviewed ledger and observed the balance dropped to $1,320.40 on 02/24/2026 before payroll posted on 02/27/2026, causing the monthly minimum violation.
- Customer requested a courtesy reversal, noting four years of account tenure without prior fee waivers.
- System records confirm no fee waivers granted in the previous 12-month period.

## Resolution and Action Items
Agent offered a one-time courtesy adjustment under discretionary retention tier 1 authority.
- Reversal credited to account 4409-8812-04 in the amount of $25.00 on 03/12/2026.
- Customer advised that avoiding future monthly charges requires maintaining a minimum daily balance of $5,000.00.
- Customer accepted terms and requested confirmation via email to address on file.

errors.quote: Caller identity verified via one-time passcode to primary mobile phone.
errors.explanation: Standard banking customer verification protocol requires two points of authentication; verifying only via a one-time passcode without verifying primary account identifiers (such as mother's maiden name or last four of SSN) is an incomplete verification log.
errors.fix: Caller identity verified via one-time passcode to primary mobile phone and confirmation of last four digits of SSN.

errors.quote: maintaining a minimum daily balance of $5,000.00.
errors.explanation: The document notes the customer keeps a balance above $1,500.00 and was assessed the fee when it dropped to $1,320.40, showing the minimum daily balance requirement is $1,500.00, not $5,000.00.
errors.fix: maintaining a minimum daily balance of $1,500.00.
